Official @supabase/supabase-js 2.117.2, MIT licensed. Bundled with its npm
runtime dependencies using esbuild 0.28.2, browser ESM, target Safari 15.
Source: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js
Build command: esbuild node_modules/@supabase/supabase-js/dist/index.mjs --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=safari15 --minify --legal-comments=eof --outfile=supabase.mjs
The included LICENSE is the upstream Supabase license. Dependency license
notices are preserved at the end of the bundle. No external CDN is used.
